description: This file contains Sass mixins for styling images, including responsive images and retina-specific background images, as part of a UI theme.

methods.name: img-responsive
methods.description: Mixin to make images responsive by setting display, max-width, and height properties.

methods.name: img-retina
methods.description: Mixin to set high-resolution background images for retina displays, including media queries for different high-density screens.
